nav.label: Main
home.title: AIDM UI is running
home.body: Engine setup is not available in this version yet.
login.title: Enter the passphrase
login.body: The operator of this AIDM UI set a passphrase. Enter it to continue.
login.label: Passphrase
settings.title: Settings
settings.port.title: Port
settings.port.current: AIDM UI is listening on port {port} now.
settings.port.label: Port to use
settings.port.hint: Leave it empty to use {port}. A new port applies the next time you start AIDM UI.
settings.port.saved: Port saved. It applies the next time you start AIDM UI.
settings.lan.title: Local network
settings.lan.explain: When this is on, other devices on the network need the passphrase to use AIDM UI. This computer does not.
settings.lan.switch: Open AIDM UI to my local network
settings.lan.passphrase_hint: At least {min} characters. Write it down, because AIDM UI cannot show it again.
settings.lan.addresses_title: On a tablet or another computer on the same network, open one of these addresses:
settings.lan.no_addresses: AIDM UI found no network address on this computer. Check that it is connected to the network.
settings.lan.saved_on: AIDM UI is now open to your local network.
settings.lan.saved_off: AIDM UI is now closed to your local network.
api.not_found: AIDM UI could not find what you asked for.
api.method_not_allowed: AIDM UI does not accept that action.
api.invalid_body: AIDM UI could not read what was sent. Check the values and try again.
api.too_many_streams: Too many open windows are following AIDM UI. Close some and reload this page.
server.internal_error: Something went wrong in AIDM UI. Try again. If it keeps happening, restart AIDM UI.
interface.not_found: This page does not exist in AIDM UI.
interface.not_built: The screens of AIDM UI are missing from this copy. Install AIDM UI again.
auth.lan_disabled: AIDM UI is closed to the local network. To open it, change the setting on the computer that runs AIDM UI.
auth.host_not_allowed: AIDM UI does not accept this address. Use an address shown in the settings of the computer that runs AIDM UI.
auth.origin_not_allowed: AIDM UI refused this request because it came from another website. Open AIDM UI directly and try again.
auth.passphrase_required: Enter the passphrase to use AIDM UI from this device.
auth.passphrase_wrong: That passphrase is not right. Check it and try again.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong passphrases. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
settings.lan_local_only: Only the computer that runs AIDM UI can change this setting.
settings.port_invalid: Enter a port between {min} and {max}, or leave it empty.
settings.passphrase_too_short: The passphrase needs at least {min} characters.
network.unreachable: AIDM UI does not answer. Check that it is still running, then try again.
engines.title: Engines
engines.empty: No engine has been added yet.
engines.live_paused: Live updates are paused. AIDM UI is trying to connect again.
engine.error_detail: The engine answered with an error: {message}
engine.form.name: Name
engine.form.token_hint_add: The token the engine gave you. AIDM UI keeps it on this computer and never shows it again.
engine.form.token_hint_edit: Leave it empty to keep the saved token. To test the connection, type the token again.
engine.address_invalid: That address is not valid. Start it with http:// or https://, for example https://engine.example.com.
engine.https_required: This address needs https://. Plain http:// is allowed only for engines on this computer or on your own network.
engine.plain_http_local: This address uses plain HTTP. Use it only on a network you trust.
engine.unreachable: No engine answered at this address. Check the address and that the engine is running.
engine.bad_response: Something answered at this address, but it does not look like an AIDM engine.
engine.unsupported_version: This engine uses API version {version}. AIDM UI needs {minimum} or newer.
engine.not_found: AIDM UI could not find that engine. It may have been removed.
engine.token_required: Type the token again when you change the address.
sample.title: Sample job
sample.intro: Try AIDM with a small set of public drone photos. AIDM UI downloads the photos, sends them to the engine you choose and shows you the result.
sample.dataset.title: The photos
sample.reference: Measured on a {cores}-core test machine with {memory} GiB of memory ({architecture}): {time}. Your computer may be faster or slower.
sample.reference_none: No time was measured for this kind of computer, so AIDM UI cannot say how long the sample job takes.
sample.peak: Measured on a test machine: the sample job used up to {size} GiB of memory.
sample.engine.title: Where to run it
sample.engine.label: Engine
sample.engine.none: No engine can run the sample job yet.
sample.engine.go_to_engines: Go to the engines page to add or check an engine
sample.start_hint: The download starts when you press the button. It is {size}.
sample.memory_below_peak: This engine may use {cap} GiB of memory. The sample job needs more than {peak} GiB.
sample.memory_unknown: AIDM UI does not know how much memory this engine may use, so it cannot tell whether the sample job fits.
sample.engine_not_usable: This engine is not ready to take work. Check it on the engines page.
sample.already_running: A sample job is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
sample.dataset_invalid: The sample photos could not be checked, so AIDM UI did not use them. Try again later.
download.failed: The download stopped before it finished. Check your internet connection and try again.
download.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file is not the one AIDM UI expected, so it was discarded. Try again.
download.not_enough_space: There is not enough free space on this computer for the download. Free some space and try again.
run.not_found: AIDM UI could not find that run.
run.not_cancellable: This run has already finished, so it cannot be cancelled.
run.results_not_ready: The results are not ready to download yet.
run.upload_failed: AIDM UI could not send the images to the engine. Check that the engine is running, then try again.
run.engine_refused: The engine refused to start this run.
run.cancelled_without_engine: The run was stopped here, but the engine did not answer. If it comes back, it may still finish the work.
run.engine_lost: The engine no longer has this run. It may have been restarted or cleaned up.
run.interrupted: AIDM UI was closed while it prepared this run. Start the sample job again.
run.state.uploading: Sending the images to the engine
run.state.queued: Waiting for the engine to start
run.state.processing: The engine is processing the images
run.state.unknown: The engine reported a status AIDM UI does not know
run.restarted: The engine restarted, so this run started over.
run.live_paused: Live updates are paused. AIDM UI is trying to connect again.
